title: The Fall of Ai

questions.question: What strategy did God give Joshua for taking Ai?
options: Set an ambush behind the city
questions.correctAnswer: Set an ambush behind the city
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:2 (ESV): "...Lay an ambush against the city, behind it."

questions.question: What was Joshua to do with his javelin?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:18 (ESV): "Then the Lord said to Joshua, 'Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai...'"

questions.question: What did the men in the ambush do when Joshua stretched out his hand?
options: They rose quickly, entered the city, and set it on fire
questions.correctAnswer: They rose quickly, entered the city, and set it on fire
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:19 (ESV): "And the men in the ambush rose quickly... and they entered the city and took it and hurried to set the city on fire."

questions.question: What happened to the King of Ai?
options: He was taken alive, hanged on a tree, then buried under a heap of stones
questions.correctAnswer: He was taken alive, hanged on a tree, then buried under a heap of stones
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:29 (ESV): "And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening..."

questions.question: After the victory, where did Joshua build an altar?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:30 (ESV): "At that time Joshua built an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal..."

questions.question: How many people of Ai fell that day?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:25 (ESV): "And all who fell that day, both men and women, were 12,000, all the people of Ai."

questions.question: What were the Israelites allowed to take from Ai this time?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:27 (ESV): "Only the livestock and the spoil of that city Israel took as their plunder..."

questions.question: What did Joshua write on the stones of the altar?
options: A copy of the law of Moses
questions.correctAnswer: A copy of the law of Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:32 (ESV): "And there, in the presence of the people of Israel, he wrote on the stones a copy of the law of Moses..."

questions.question: Where did half the people stand while the law was read?
options: In front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal
questions.correctAnswer: In front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:33 (ESV): "...half of them in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal..."

questions.question: What type of stones was the altar made of?
options: Uncut stones, upon which no man has wielded an iron tool
questions.correctAnswer: Uncut stones, upon which no man has wielded an iron tool
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:31 (ESV): "...an altar of uncut stones, upon which no man has wielded an iron tool..."

questions.question: How many men did Joshua choose for the ambush initially mentioned in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:3 (ESV): "So Joshua chose 30,000 men, mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night."

questions.question: Verse 12 mentions another number for the ambush. How many?
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:12 (ESV): "And he took about 5,000 men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai..."

questions.question: The King of Ai went out to meet Israel at a certain place. Where?
options: At the descent of the Arabah
questions.correctAnswer: At the descent of the Arabah
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:14 (ESV): "...the men of the city went out to meet Israel in battle... at the descent of the Arabah."

questions.question: Did the men of Ai leave the city open?
options: Yes, not a man was left in Ai or Bethel
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, not a man was left in Ai or Bethel
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:17 (ESV): "There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel. They left the city open..."

questions.question: How long did Joshua keep his hand stretched out?
options: Until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai to destruction
questions.correctAnswer: Until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai to destruction
questions.explanation: Joshua 8:26 (ESV): "For Joshua did not draw back his hand with which he stretched out the javelin until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai to destruction."

key_verse_text: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Take all the fighting men with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, his city, and his land. (ESV)
